Implementation Plan

Clarification Mapping
- No Q<ID> questions were issued in Clarify; the auto-response `/answer [auto-answered-by-clarify]` indicates the scope is considered fully specified, so planning proceeds without additional clarification.

Implementation Plan

1. Files Likely To Change
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`
- `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`
- Optional, only if this behavior is documented elsewhere: `README.md` (likely not needed unless a branch-scope statement exists outside script comments)

2. Functions/Modules To Implement Or Update
- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`:
- Standalone conflict sweep block (around the `# Standalone PR conflict sweep` section).
- Keep using the existing helper `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts()` (do not replace flow).
- Representative pattern to follow: existing two-stage conflict handling already used in tracked PR flows (`update-branch` first, dispatch review on failure). Reuse this behavior in standalone sweep exactly.
- `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`:
- `_run_poller(...)` harness and embedded `gh` mock behavior to simulate:
- `pulls/{pr}/update-branch` success/failure.
- Review workflow dispatch calls (`gh workflow run ai-review.yml|internal-review.yml|review_autofix.yml`).
- Optional active-run checks (`gh run list`) if validating that guard explicitly.
- Add new standalone-sweep-focused tests and adjust existing standalone test coverage.

3. Planned Logic Changes
- Remove the hard branch-name filter in standalone sweep:
- Delete/replace `if [[ "${S_HEAD}" != ai/issue-* ]]; then continue; fi`.
- Preserve current safety guards:
- Continue skipping orchestrator internal PRs by base pattern (`orchestrator/project-*`).
- Continue gating by `mergeable_state == dirty`.
- Continue two-stage handling:
- Stage 1: `PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr}/update-branch`.
- Stage 2 fallback: `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts`.
- Add defensive eligibility checks for safety/races:
- Explicitly skip when PR state is no longer open after detail fetch (race-safe even if list was open).
- Keep handling missing/unavailable head refs as non-fatal skip with warning log.
- Ensure failures are fail-open:
- Fork/permission/head-ref dispatch failures should log warning and continue loop.
- Do not terminate script on these failures.
- Update comments in the standalone section to reflect new scope:
- From “AI-generated branches (ai/issue-*)” to “all eligible open PRs”.

4. Data Structures Affected
- Shell/runtime variables in standalone sweep:
- `S_PR`, `S_HEAD`, `S_BASE`, `S_PR_JSON`, `S_MERGEABLE_STATE`, plus any new `S_STATE`-style guard variable.
- Test harness store object in `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`:
- Likely add fields to track review dispatches and configurable update-branch failure behavior.
- No persistent DB schema/index/contracts impacted.

5. API/Interface Changes
- No external user-facing API change.
- Operational behavior change:
- Standalone conflict sweep eligibility expands from `ai/issue-*` head branches to all eligible open PRs.
- Existing GitHub API/workflow interfaces remain:
- `pulls/{pr}/update-branch` attempt first.
- `gh workflow run <review-workflow> --ref <head_ref> -f pr_number=<pr>` fallback.
- Duplicate-dispatch and active-run protections remain enforced via `_dispatch_review_for_conflicts`.

6. Risks And Edge Cases
- Increased sweep scope may increase API calls and dispatch attempts on large repos.
- Fork PRs or inaccessible head refs can fail dispatch; must remain warning-only.
- `mergeable_state` can be transient (`unknown`); continue skipping until stable to avoid false actions.
- Race condition: PR can close/change between list and detail fetch; explicit open-state check prevents unintended handling.
- Avoid regressions in orchestrator-managed PR handling by preserving base-branch exclusion.

7. Testing Considerations
- Add/adjust tests to cover required acceptance criteria:
- Non-`ai/issue-*` dirty open PR now enters conflict handling path.
- Existing `ai/issue-*` dirty behavior still works.
- Orchestrator internal exclusion still skips (`baseRefName=orchestrator/project-*`).
- Duplicate-dispatch/active-run guard still prevents duplicate review dispatch.
- Closed PRs are skipped safely.
- Harness updates needed so tests can assert fallback dispatch behavior deterministically (current mock should explicitly model update-branch + review dispatch outcomes).
- Suggested test execution:
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 pytest tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`

Conflict Detection Notes
- Found pre-existing comment/code drift in standalone sweep comments: comments describe AI-branch-only scope and direct Codex resolution, while current flow is update-branch + review workflow dispatch. This should be corrected as part of this change so docs/comments match actual behavior.
